summary.title: The definitive guide to learning functional programming
summary.one_liner: A community-curated forum thread listing free and paid courses, books, blog posts and videos for learning functional programming, mostly centred on Haskell, with some Clojure, F#, Scala and JavaScript resources.
keywords: parallel and concurrent programming in haskell
takeaways: Exercism's Elixir and F# tracks and the Clojure track offer structured practice in functional concepts.
Books such as Algebra-Driven Design, Purely Functional Data Structures and Parallel and Concurrent Programming in Haskell cover FP ideas beyond any single language.
Learn You a Haskell, Programming in Haskell and Real World Haskell are recommended Haskell books, though some commenters note Real World Haskell is dated.
Free video and blog resources include Scott Wlaschin's F# talks, Tweag's Haskell videos, and Alexis King's posts on types and parsing.
Commenters suggest Getting Clojure and the 'Clojure in a nutshell' talk as introductions to Clojure, and a JavaScript-based FP book for accessibility.
summary.summary: This forum thread from Exercism, posted for Functional February, collects recommendations from the community for learning functional programming. It is split into sections on courses, general FP books, Haskell-specific books and videos, blog posts by Alexis King, and Clojure, F#, and Scala resources, with short comments from readers explaining why each item helped them. The thread is a list of links and opinions rather than a tutorial, so the details come from individual recommendations.
